label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast

Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage. We want to do the christmas breakfast at your place again like always. Saturday Dec 19 if the back room is open, 7am same time as last year. If the 19th is no good then the 12th would work, whichever one is easier on you, just let me know. Same setup as last year, big pans of eggs and home fries and biscuits and gravy, everybody orders their own meat off the menu, that all worked good.

Count is 24. Dwayne sent me the sheet off the board in the drivers room, thats 19 drivers and 3 from the shop plus Earl and his wife Carol so 24 all together. I'll get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you asked so your not standing there with food you can't use.

Two things I need to ask about. Patsy cant do eggs anymore, she said oatmeal or pancakes or whatever shes got would be fine, whatever you can fix her. And Lonnie is on a walker since his hip, so he needs to come in the side door, the one with no steps. I hope thats not a problem, I can have somebody bring him around and set him at a table close to the door so he isnt walking all over the place.

About coffee. We ran you out about 8:15 last year when the urn quit and I know you felt bad about it, it wasn't your fault, we all had seconds anyhow. Could you get a backup coffee pot to go with the main one, just so we don't have to be asking you for more in the middle of things? I know that's asking a lot but it would save you some trouble. Coffee is always good and everybody drinks a lot of it.

Now I want to talk to you about doing something for Earl. His last day driving is December 18, he drove 31 years, so the 19th is the day after. He has no idea about this so please dont say a word to him, dont even hint at it. He would be embarrassed by a big speech but he'd like it if the guys did something small. Could we bring a cake in from Sugarcreek Bakery, a half sheet with a little bus on top? Or if you would rather, could you do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls with a candle in it? I honestly think your cinnamon rolls are better than any cake and Earl loves them, but if a cake is simpler on you then the bakery can handle it. Your call, whatever you think is best.

Price wise $11 a head was fair last year and if its up a little thats ok, I know what everything costs these days. Separate checks again like we did last year, that worked out fine for everybody.

Let me know on the date, the side door and the coffee pot when you get a chance. I'll call you if I don't hear back. Thanks Rhonda, Merry Christmas to you too
Gary Hollins

reasons: The draft never actually asks Rhonda for this year's per-person price; it only says $11 was fair last year and that a small increase is fine.
It does not ask this year's per-person breakfast price.
